findings.claim: Column-derived tenant CDC mutations are published on the fixed config tenant channel, allowing the envelope tenant and payload tenant to diverge and breaking tenant isolation.
findings.evidence: In `run_inner`, the `Channel` is constructed once with `tenant_id: self.config.tenant_id`; `publish_commit` then uses `channel: channel.clone()` for every mutation, while `decode.rs` extracts `mutation.tenant_id` from `TenantMode::Column` source data. Constraint S4 requires tenant isolation and an app-layer tenant-equality guard, but no equality check or per-mutation channel tenant assignment exists.
findings.suggested_fix: Either reject column-tenant rows whose decoded tenant differs from the configured channel tenant before publishing, or construct/ensure the event channel per mutation using `mutation.tenant_id` so envelope tenant and payload tenant always match.
